text: A1 (verifies R1) (manual): WHEN the list shows an inactive and an active supplier, the inactive one appears greyed out and the active one does not; both are present.

comments.text: The criterion is marked (manual), but a test could decide it: it can check that both rows are in the list and that the inactive row carries the greyed-out state (for example a style or CSS class) while the active row does not. Remove the (manual) marker, or keep it only if greyed-out appearance genuinely needs a person's eye.
